Alex - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum: 

1) Outcomes from the call:
- Primary use case: live chat triage + knowledge base retrieval for support workflows.
- Scale estimate: ~30k queries/day initially, growing to ~150k in 6 months.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for short prompts, average embedding accuracy > 0.92 on internal evals.

2) Stakeholders you mentioned:
- Alex Wu (Product lead) - owner of evaluation
- Priya Sharma (IT Security) - security sign-off
- Michael Lee (CFO) - economic buyer
- Procurement (procurement@finpay.com) - contract steps

3) Proposed MAP (high level):
- Week 1: Share MAP + SOC2 summary (we'll attach) - Marissa
- Week 2: Security review + procurement kickoff - Priya/Procurement
- Week 3: Pilot rollout config + metrics baseline - Alex/Eng
- Week 6: Business review + contract finalization - Michael/Procurement

Requests / next steps for you: please confirm the stakeholder list (especially economic buyer) and if the timing above looks right. I'll attach a draft MAP and our SOC2 summary for your security team.

Thanks - happy to jump on a short call with procurement/security if useful.

--
